candidate_windows.window_text:
We use the lower-cased BERT-base model with 12 hidden layers, 12 attention heads, hidden size 768, for training our style classifiers on GeForce GTX TITAN X GPU. Drop-out rate is 0.1, learning rate is $2 \times 10^{-5}$ , and the optimizer is AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017). Vocabulary size is 30,522 and max position embeddings is 512. Training ran forInstructions Thank you for participating in this study! Please read the instructions carefully.

(WARNING: This study may contain offensive words which may be upsetting)

You will be given 20 pairs of a sentence and a style from this list: politeness (polite or impolite), senti (positive or negative), emotions (anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness), and offensiveness.

1. Choose the most appropriate style for the given sentence.   
2. Choose the word(s) which make you think the sentence has that style.Example 1: This cake is delicious What is the sentiment of this text?: Positive

Word that makes it positive: deliciousExample 2: Their encouragement helps her finish the task What is the sentiment of this text?: Positive   
Words that make it positive: encouragement, helpExample 3: The movie is boring What is the sentiment of this text?: Negative

Word that makes it negative: boring

3. Don't reload the page.   
4. There will be a practice section and a short survey before you begin. You need to pass this practice section to do this task. You need to fill in your prolific ID to get paid.Input Text: ![](images/62cdb5815a2c61907e262b554ddfe5c9716f980f241ae4e6536a35b058e9c9c5.jpg)  
Figure 6: Instruction page for crowd workers.What is the sentiment of the input text? Positive Neutral Negative If you select "Positive" or "Negative", please click the word(s) in the input text that makes you to the sentence is "Positive" or "Negative" until the word color becomes blue.

![](images/ea26b330f8ce12501fdae2db6a555705162cbabde0aa443b85bc870d785f1bb7.jpg)  
Figure 7: Annotation page for crowd workers.Demographic Survey 1. Age* (in years) $\mathrm{O} <   18$ 25-34 55-74Asian Pacific Islander   
○18-24 ○35-44 >74 Caucasian Middle Eastern

O45-54 African Others2. Gender* Female   
Male   
Others/Non-binary

Hispanic/Latino   
$\odot$ Native American

$\bigcirc$ Master's Degree   
O Doctoral Degree

$\bigcirc$ Professional Degree (Law, Medical etc.)

![](images/8d3bbfd0b95b1a9a303093892aacde9714d25d02bdd0c072073869fa1c812f20.jpg)  
Figure 8: Demographic survey for crowd workers.

3 epochs, and each epoch took around 4 minutes.
